protocol: Six physical-core counts, with the caller participating only in the six-core pool arm. Use the same real expert weights, seeded native activations and ordered jobs throughout. The scan reads an independent contiguous buffer equal to the unique weight footprint. Match worker cores, caller placement, first touch and caller participation between workloads. Three independent process rounds per cell, five scored batches per process. Hashing, allocation, quantizing initial activations, output validation and warmup precede timing. Production pool scheduling, GU, hidden quantization and Down are timed. Logical weight bytes and the sequential-read reference are component evidence.
